The jab follows Apple's September 9, 2026 announcement of the iPhone Duo, its first book-style foldable iPhone. Samsung is highlighting its head start in the category, having launched the original Galaxy Fold in 2019.

The ad is another example of the long-running Samsung vs Apple smartphone rivalry, with both companies using social media and advertising to take playful shots at each other's technology. 📱⚔️

title: Sniglet & Monica｜Serial Hug Killer Vs Routine Cop Visit
description:
👉 Sniglet ties Monica up inside the house when the doorbell rings out of nowhere. He freezes at once, whispering harshly to order Monica to stay completely silent, then hurries toward the door, fully convinced cops have tracked him down for arresting him, the serial hug killer.👀
👉 He carefully cracks open the door, only to find a regular patrol officer standing outside. The officer stays calm, no gun drawn and no suspect interrogation. It’s just a routine community safety check. He warns about recent home burglaries nearby and reaches out to hand Sniglet a police contact card.⚡
👉 Sniglet is on edge, panicking inside, ready for his hostage crime to be exposed at any moment. But the officer’s eyes drift to the smoke alarm on the wall, seriously reminding him the low-battery light is on and he needs to replace the battery soon — fire hazards are the real top killer.🔥

🔥 Key Moments:
Sniglet binds Monica and hears the sudden doorbell ring
Sniglet thinks police come to arrest him for being the serial hug killer
Patrol cop drops by just for routine community safety visit
Cop warns about local break-ins and tries to hand over contact card
Terrified Sniglet braces for his crime to get exposed
Cop shifts focus, reminds Sniglet to fix the low-battery smoke alarm
Intense hostage tension clashes with mundane home safety lecture

💬 Question: Can you believe the cop totally missed the hostage and only cared about the smoke alarm?👇🤔
